response.rationale: The product provides a legal name ('Chicken soup with vegetables'), which is a descriptive name and not just a brand or fancy name, satisfying the first requirement. For the QUID requirement, the ingredients 'Chicken' and 'Vegetable' (represented by carrots, leeks, celery, etc.) appear in the name of the food ('Chicken & Vegetable Soup'), and their percentages are declared in the ingredient list (Chicken stock 52%, Chicken 18%, Carrots 11%, Leeks 7%, CELERY 2%). This satisfies the requirement for quantitative indication of ingredients that appear in the name of the food.

citations.quoted_span: The indication of the quantity of an ingredient or category of ingredients used in the manufacture or preparation of a food shall be required where the ingredient or category of ingredients concerned: (a) appears in the name of the food or is usually associated with that name by the consumer;
